name: Baroque: Yuganda Mousou
summary:
This is the limited edition release of the PlayStation port of the roguelike RPG Baroque. Titled Baroque: Yuganda Mousou (Distorted Delusion), this version enhances the original Sega Saturn release with new story elements, cutscenes, and difficulty adjustments. The "Genteiban" (Limited Edition) specifically includes the game disc along with a special "Shin Tenshimushi" keyholder figure

In the game, the player assumes the role of an amnesiac protagonist in a post-apocalyptic world warped by a cataclysm known as the "Blaze." To find redemption and purify the world, the protagonist must descend into the mysterious, shifting Neuro Tower.
